publication: New output only; publish after every-pair validation and independent byte-identical regeneration; preserve content-hashed executable source snapshot

rule.actions: Raw source actions [t, t+h); exactly h actions, target action excluded
rule.anchors: Every integer t with 0 <= t < episode_length - h
rule.conditioning: Instruction, state and both images at t; no future observations
rule.order: Per split: ascending episode_index, then horizon, then anchor
rule.pair_digest: SHA256(ASCII eventground_wam.future_image_pair.v1 + NUL + raw source_digest + struct.pack('<IIIBB', episode,anchor,target,h,split))
rule.policy_samples: Does not filter B0 action anchors; later auxiliary losses need masks
rule.target: Frame t+h from the same episode and both cameras
rule.test_payloads: Forbidden; test assignment metadata is used only for isolation checks
rule.transforms: None; source 256x256 dual-camera frame references, no cache or resize
rule.weighting: Index coverage only; training mixture and exposure budget remain unfrozen

source_validation.all_train_validation_payloads: Verify size and SHA-256 against pinned source inventory
source_validation.decode_smoke: First episode by ID for each task and selected split; decode all synchronized frames and RGB24 conversion (80 episodes)
source_validation.telemetry: Validate every selected Parquet row/schema/time with DemonstrationReader
source_validation.test_payloads: Do not read, hash, probe or decode
source_validation.video_headers: Check frame count, 20 Hz, AV1, 256x256 for both cameras of all selected episodes
